claims.statement: For the two-bit AND/point-defect gate, J_X <= M_X + delta(p)/2 for every p in [1/64,49/100] and q in [0,1].
claims.scope: Genuine two-bit Boolean gates under product bias, after symmetry reduction; no higher arity or hierarchy transfer.
claims.source_defect: Both original Decimal checkers compute ONE-x in the default 28-digit context inside h_point, contrary to their claimed 70-digit directed evaluation.
claims.repair: Use a 70-digit directed interval for ONE-x and propagate it through log2 and multiplication.
claims.first_unpaid_line: Uniform higher-arity and nonreusing hierarchy payment of M+delta/2 with terminal terms.
